scope: The currently compiled arXiv manuscript; optional omitted exponent sections are excluded. This inventory counts explicit statement environments, not every assertion in prose.

claims.title: Regularity and scaling for the main results
claims.label: main:ass:regularity-scaling

claims.title: Existence of a sublinear oracle sampler
claims.label: main:thm:upper-curve
claims.note: Actual TV/KL public sampler for every allowed cutoff, with uniform query/round/grouped-depth envelopes and literal vocabulary growth. Actual balanced total calls including preprocessing and parallel depth are o(N). The target-error substitutions are exact scalar calibrations; the displayed main error bounds are weaker than the proved allocations.

claims.title: Fixed-accuracy query--round lower bound
claims.label: main:thm:lower-envelope
claims.note: Full ordinary commit feedback, arbitrary finite vocabulary, actual public class, and literal vocabulary growth. The lower alternative is pointwise for each sufficiently large even N.

claims.title: Nonlinear finite adaptive query--round lower bound
claims.label: app:thm:nonlinear-finite-lower
claims.note: Actual finite minimax theorem for the full observed controller. Commit feedback is simulated with exact output/risk and unchanged charged Q/R; the stronger free-current-marginal disclosure theorem is proved.

claims.title: Nonlinear finite target-error tradeoff
claims.label: app:cor:nonlinear-finite-target-tradeoff
claims.note: Full observed-controller target-error corollary, including zero-round impossibility.

claims.title: Local facts for the hard matching family
claims.label: app:lem:hard-local-facts
claims.note: The four local assertions are proved in the listed component theorems.

claims.title: Finite hard-family inclusion
claims.label: app:prop:hard-family-inclusion
claims.note: Actual forest target, complete-boundary RT/UEN, bijective nonincreasing RF ranking, and selected-oracle squared-Hellinger accuracy are all proved. Vocabulary-growth is a separate asymptotic assumption.

claims.title: Commit kernels and adaptive midpoint law
claims.label: app:eq:hard-exact-batch-law

claims.title: Adaptive midpoint identity
claims.label: app:lem:adaptive-midpoint-lower

claims.title: Unresolved edges and the analytic record

claims.title: Equality-test disclosure
claims.label: app:lem:query-disclosure

claims.title: Adaptive collision lower tail
claims.label: app:prop:collision-lower-tail

claims.note: Actual adaptive reached-call failure probability under independent finite color blocks, with arbitrary fixed batch kernel including oracle products and true joint reference. No adaptive-freshness premise remains.

claims.label: app:def:kl-oracle-risk

Joint-reference chain rule and KL decomposition

claims.label: app:lem:adaptive-joint-kl

claims.title: \KLCaseTitle: finite randomized forward-KL upper bound
claims.label: app:thm:finite-kl-upper
claims.note: Actual finite sampler under forward-KL oracle accuracy, with KL <= N*kappa + N*log|V|*eta and the same query/round/depth bounds. No abstract safety/failure premise remains.

claims.title: \KLCaseTitle\ with output KL at most epsilon
claims.label: app:cor:kl-epsilon
claims.note: The concrete choices sqrt(epsilon/2), epsilon/(2N), and epsilon/(2N log V) give actual seed KL <= epsilon under the stated feasible preprocessing and signal conditions.

claims.title: Public feasibility with a half-signal tail tolerance
claims.label: app:lem:benchmark-feasibility
claims.note: The original clipped dyadic grid is used. Its selected threshold has the half-signal bracket and the actual bank-column bound; no continuous threshold surrogate is used.

claims.title: Signal-calibrated finite query--round lower bound
claims.label: app:cor:signal-calibrated-finite-lower
claims.note: Arbitrary public signal and independent radius, actual finite calibrated family, full commit observations, and arbitrary-vocabulary public-class restriction. Both the exact printed integer floor/8 and finite minimum are retained; the benchmark floor specialization is explicit.

claims.title: Fixed-accuracy main-text bounds
claims.label: app:cor:fixed-accuracy-main
claims.note: The actual appendix allocations TV eta=rho/2 and KL eta=rho^2/(N log V) have uniform all-cutoff error/resource envelopes and actual balanced total/depth o(N). The independent-radius full-feedback arbitrary-vocabulary public lower theorem is also proved.

claims.label: app:lem:finite-hellinger-calculus

claims.title: KL-to-Hellinger comparison; \textcolor{red}{{\citealp[Eq.~(7.33)
claims.label: app:lem:kl-hellinger
claims.note: Finite positive laws; both orientations follow by swapping arguments and Hellinger symmetry.

claims.title: Forest degree sum and tree centroid
claims.label: app:lem:forest-basics
claims.note: Finite forest edge/degree identities and tree centroid existence; empty graphs are handled in the identities.

claims.title: Invariance under public row selection
claims.label: app:prop:row-selector-invariance
claims.note: Actual sampler for any public-memory Policy; policy sees current history, colors, and completed state/reply table but no future colors. Same grid/risk/query/round/depth guarantees are proved; identical executions or errors across policies are not asserted.

claims.title: A shared-class path with linear TC and DTC
claims.label: app:prop:path-in-class
claims.note: Actual positive path with exact S0/C0, RF, RT, UEN and exact oracle; TC=(N-1)c and DTC=c+(N-2)c_prime with positive constants independent of vocabulary. Explicit two-sided linear bounds are proved. Both oracle accuracy conditions and eventual actual benchmark membership are explicit, uniformly in vocabulary.

claims.title: Linear effective TC on the comparison path
claims.label: app:cor:path-effective-tc
claims.note: Actual independently masked full target, exact conditional MI given the entire masked exterior, ordered pairs, and min(1,t) integral. Explicit positive linear constants are fixed before path length and vocabulary. Integrability is proved; no external TC/DTC comparison is an axiom.

coverage_convention: proved refers only to the listed claim under its formalized hypotheses; partial_or_conditional does not certify the full paper result. Interfaces and prose need separate correspondence checks. Compile and run AuditAxioms.lean; inventory is not itself proof evidence.
manuscript_revision_note: The recorded commit is the base before the September 29 Lean disclosure, reference-load-order fix, and public-code availability edits. Exact released sources are identified by the compiled-input hashes.
